title: Time-series hyperspectral sensing decodes physiological dynamics and latent-stage detection of Tetranychus urticae infestation in strawberry plants

key_findings: T. urticae causes measurable physiological changes in strawberry leaves
time-aware non-destructive sensing can support latent-stage detection
hyperspectral modality is not treated as interchangeable with thermal imaging

notes: Same crop and mite species but different sensing modality. Supports physiological/temporal framing, not thermal threshold transfer.
